hist.pl: The gate of Dvārakā; the road
hist.story: The city is asleep, and one man is not. He comes to the gate in a garland of lotuses. He carries no weapon. The guard sees him and does not know what to say. The man nods and goes out. A footprint is left in the dust. The gate closes. The guard stands there a long time.
hist.sum: Krishna, unarmed and wearing a lotus garland, walks out through the city gate while the people sleep in safety. A guard watches him go.
hist.t: The lone walk from the gate
hist.why: The one man who goes out alone to absorb the threat; the image Rukmini carries of him.
